full_judgment: Md Hassan Ameen J : These two appeals, namely, (1) Criminal Appeal No. 545 of 2003 preferred by accused-appellant Muhammad Faridul Mollah and (2) Criminal Appeal No. 714 of 2003 preferred by accused-appellant Muhammad Nuruzzaman Gazi, are directed against the judgment and order, dated 8-1-2003, passed by learned Special Tribunal No. 3, Satkhira, in the case No. 123 of 2001 arising out of GR No. 144 of 2001 (Debhata) corresponding to Kaliganj PS case No. 14 date 29-6-2001, convicting them (accused appellants) under sections 19A and (f) of the Arms Act and sentencing them to suffer rigorous imprisonment for ten years and also convicting them under section 25B(1)(b) of the Special Powers Act, 1974 and sentencing them to suffer rigorous imprisonment for two years and to pay a fine of Taka 5,000 each for both the offences, in default to suffer imprisonment for one year more.
